newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Demand surge lifts prices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Demand surge lifts prices.

text.p: A sudden rise in demand prompted price increases in several millfeed markets Wednesday, but dealers said the gains may be short-lived.
Recent gains in corn and soymeal prices in Chicago Board of Trade futures markets may have encouraged feed mixers to order feed ingredients now before prices rise further, dealers said.

Most of the price gains were in the central and southern Plains and in the southeast markets. Sources in the Carolinas said hog farms were buying moderate amounts of millfeeds, soybean hulls, hominy and corn gluten feed.
In north Texas, millfeed offers jumped $5.00 since Tuesday to $70 per ton for shipment by next week because of tight supplies for prompt shipment.
Kansas City rail offers rose $5.00 to $55.00. Dealers said completion of the wheat harvest in southern Kansas and Oklahoma had farmers and ranchers catching up on livestock feed purchases.
